title: BBQ Chicken and Cheddar Quesadillas
description: A crisp tortilla dinner using leftover chicken and a little barbecue sauce. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library. The side salsa and guacamole are serving suggestions.
ingredients_list: {"4 8-inch flour tortillas","1 1/2 cups cooked shredded chicken","3/4 cup shredded cheddar","1/4 cup barbecue sauce","1 teaspoon oil"}
shopping_list: {"4 8-inch flour tortillas","1 1/2 cups cooked shredded chicken","3/4 cup shredded cheddar","1/4 cup barbecue sauce","1 teaspoon oil"}
recipe_steps: {"Warm the chicken with the barbecue sauce in a covered microwave-safe bowl, stirring until it reaches 165°F.","Divide the chicken and cheese over half of each tortilla; fold closed.","Heat a large skillet over medium-low with the oil. Cook two folded tortillas at a time, 2–3 minutes per side, until crisp and melted. Cut into wedges."}

title: Salsa Chicken Tacos
description: Warm salsa chicken tacos without waiting for a slow cooker. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library. Shows the chicken filling; lettuce and cheese are added when serving.
ingredients_list: {"1 1/2 cups cooked shredded chicken","3/4 cup mild chunky salsa","1/4 cup water","4 6-inch flour tortillas","1/2 cup shredded lettuce","1/4 cup shredded cheddar"}
shopping_list: {"1 1/2 cups cooked shredded chicken","3/4 cup mild chunky salsa","4 6-inch flour tortillas","1/2 cup shredded lettuce","1/4 cup shredded cheddar"}
recipe_steps: {"Put chicken, salsa and water in a small pan. Cover and simmer gently for 5–8 minutes, stirring, until the chicken reaches 165°F.","Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet for about 20 seconds on each side.","Spoon chicken into the tortillas and add lettuce and cheese. Serve straight away."}

title: Buffalo Chicken Sliders
description: Crispy buffalo chicken sliders made with fully cooked freezer tenders. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"8 ounces frozen fully cooked breaded chicken tenders","4 slider buns","2 tablespoons buffalo wing sauce","2 tablespoons ranch dressing","8 pickle slices"}
shopping_list: {"8 ounces frozen fully cooked breaded chicken tenders","4 slider buns","2 tablespoons buffalo wing sauce","2 tablespoons ranch dressing","8 pickle slices"}
recipe_steps: {"Heat the oven as directed on the tender package. Bake the fully cooked tenders for the package time, turning if directed, until crisp and 165°F inside; allow about 20 minutes plus preheating.","Cut tenders to fit the buns and toss with buffalo sauce. Split the buns.","Fill each bun with chicken, a little ranch and two pickle slices. Serve while crisp."}

title: Chicken Bacon Ranch Pasta
description: Creamy ranch pasta with chicken, peas and ready-cooked bacon. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"6 ounces dry cavatappi pasta","1 cup frozen peas","1 cup cooked diced chicken","3 slices fully cooked bacon, chopped","3/4 cup jarred Alfredo sauce","1 teaspoon dry ranch seasoning","1/4 cup milk"}
shopping_list: {"6 ounces dry cavatappi pasta","1 cup frozen peas","1 cup cooked diced chicken","3 slices fully cooked bacon, chopped","3/4 cup jarred Alfredo sauce","1 teaspoon dry ranch seasoning","1/4 cup milk"}
recipe_steps: {"Boil the pasta according to its package. Add peas for the last 3 minutes, then drain.","Meanwhile put Alfredo sauce, milk, ranch seasoning, chicken and bacon in a saucepan. Simmer gently for 5–7 minutes, stirring, until the chicken reaches 165°F.","Fold the drained pasta and peas into the sauce. Stir over low heat for a minute and divide between bowls."}

title: Pesto Chicken and Vegetable Skillet
description: Chicken, zucchini and peppers cooked in one skillet with jarred pesto. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast cutlets, 1/2-inch thick","1 tablespoon oil","1 medium zucchini","1 bell pepper","1 cup cherry tomatoes","3 tablespoons basil pesto","1/4 teaspoon salt"}
shopping_list: {"12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast cutlets, 1/2-inch thick","1 tablespoon oil","1 medium zucchini","1 bell pepper","1 cup cherry tomatoes","3 tablespoons basil pesto","1/4 teaspoon salt"}
recipe_steps: {"Cut zucchini into half-moons and pepper into strips. Season chicken with salt.","Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Cook chicken 4–5 minutes per side, until the thickest part reaches 165°F; transfer to a clean plate.","Put zucchini and pepper in the same skillet. Cook 6–8 minutes, stirring, then add tomatoes for 2 minutes.","Turn heat low and stir in pesto. Return the chicken and its juices; warm together for a minute."}

title: Lemon Pepper Chicken Drumsticks
description: Lemon-pepper drumsticks with potatoes and carrots on the same tray. About 10 minutes of hands-on work; 60 minutes total. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"6 chicken drumsticks","1 pound potatoes","3 medium carrots","2 tablespoons oil","2 teaspoons lemon-pepper seasoning","1/2 teaspoon salt"}
shopping_list: {"6 chicken drumsticks","1 pound potatoes","3 medium carrots","2 tablespoons oil","2 teaspoons lemon-pepper seasoning","1/2 teaspoon salt"}
recipe_steps: {"Heat oven to 425°F. Cut potatoes into 3/4-inch chunks and carrots into 1/2-inch pieces.","Toss vegetables with half the oil and salt on a large rimmed baking sheet. Coat drumsticks with the remaining oil and lemon-pepper seasoning; place alongside in one layer.","Roast 40–45 minutes, turning vegetables halfway. Check the thickest chicken away from bone reaches at least 165°F and potatoes are fork-tender; cook longer if needed.","Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving with the vegetables."}

title: Crispy Honey Mustard Chicken Tenders
description: Freezer chicken tenders with an easy honey-mustard dip. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library. The photo shows roasted vegetables; this shortcut uses a microwave vegetable side.
ingredients_list: {"10 ounces frozen fully cooked breaded chicken tenders","2 tablespoons mayonnaise","1 tablespoon honey","1 tablespoon Dijon mustard","2 cups frozen steam-in-bag vegetables"}
shopping_list: {"10 ounces frozen fully cooked breaded chicken tenders","2 tablespoons mayonnaise","1 tablespoon honey","1 tablespoon Dijon mustard","2 cups frozen steam-in-bag vegetables"}
recipe_steps: {"Bake the fully cooked tenders following the package temperature and time, until crisp and 165°F inside. The estimate allows 10 minutes to preheat and about 20 minutes to bake.","Mix mayonnaise, honey and mustard in a small bowl for dipping.","Microwave the vegetables according to their package. Serve with the tenders and dip."}

title: Teriyaki Chicken Stir-Fry
description: A takeout-style chicken stir-fry using frozen vegetables and bottled sauce. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast","1 tablespoon oil","3 cups frozen stir-fry vegetables","1/3 cup teriyaki sauce","1 8.8-ounce pouch microwave rice","2 tablespoons water"}
shopping_list: {"12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast","1 tablespoon oil","3 cups frozen stir-fry vegetables","1/3 cup teriyaki sauce","1 8.8-ounce pouch microwave rice"}
recipe_steps: {"Cut chicken into small bite-size pieces. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high.","Cook chicken for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until it reaches 165°F. Move it to a clean plate.","Add frozen vegetables and water to the pan. Cover for 4 minutes, then uncover and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until hot and tender.","Return chicken, stir in teriyaki sauce and heat for 2 minutes. Microwave rice according to the pouch and serve underneath."}

title: Sticky Apricot Chicken
description: A sweet, sticky oven chicken dinner with apricot preserves. About 10 minutes of hands-on work; 60 minutes total. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"6 bone-in skin-on chicken thighs","1/2 cup apricot preserves","1 tablespoon Dijon mustard","1 tablespoon soy sauce","1 tablespoon oil","1 15-ounce can apricot halves in juice, drained"}
shopping_list: {"6 bone-in skin-on chicken thighs","1/2 cup apricot preserves","1 tablespoon Dijon mustard","1 tablespoon soy sauce","1 tablespoon oil","1 15-ounce can apricot halves in juice, drained"}
recipe_steps: {"Heat oven to 400°F. Lightly oil a baking dish and arrange chicken skin-side up.","Mix preserves, mustard and soy sauce. Spoon half over the chicken; keep the other half in a separate clean bowl.","Bake 35 minutes. Add drained apricots around the chicken and spoon the reserved glaze over it.","Bake another 10–15 minutes, until a thermometer in the thickest part away from bone reads at least 165°F. Rest for 5 minutes."}

title: Creamy Garlic Chicken
description: Thin chicken cutlets in a quick garlic cream sauce with spinach. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast cutlets, 1/2-inch thick","1 tablespoon butter","3 garlic cloves, minced","1/2 cup chicken broth","1/3 cup heavy cream","2 cups baby spinach","1/4 teaspoon salt","1/4 teaspoon black pepper"}
shopping_list: {"12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast cutlets, 1/2-inch thick","1 tablespoon butter","3 garlic cloves, minced","1/2 cup chicken broth","1/3 cup heavy cream","2 cups baby spinach","1/4 teaspoon salt","1/4 teaspoon black pepper"}
recipe_steps: {"Season chicken with salt and pepper. Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.","Cook cutlets for 4–5 minutes per side until 165°F inside. Transfer to a clean plate.","Add garlic to the pan for 30 seconds. Pour in broth and cream, scraping the pan, then simmer gently for 3 minutes.","Stir in spinach until wilted. Return chicken and warm in the sauce for 1–2 minutes."}

title: Chicken Gravy over Instant Mash
description: Chicken and gravy over instant mashed potatoes for a very low-effort dinner. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"1 1/2 cups cooked shredded chicken","1 12-ounce jar chicken gravy","1/2 cup water","1 4-ounce pouch complete instant mashed potatoes, water-only preparation","2 cups water"}
shopping_list: {"1 1/2 cups cooked shredded chicken","1 12-ounce jar chicken gravy","1 4-ounce pouch complete instant mashed potatoes, water-only preparation"}
recipe_steps: {"Put chicken, gravy and the 1/2 cup water in a saucepan. Simmer gently, stirring, for 6–8 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F.","Prepare the complete mashed-potato pouch using the 2 cups water, or the amount of water printed on that pouch.","Divide mash between two bowls and spoon the hot chicken and gravy over it."}

title: Quick Chicken Corn Chowder
description: A chunky chicken and corn soup with tender potatoes and a creamy broth. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"1 10.5-ounce can condensed cream of chicken soup","2 cups chicken broth","1/2 cup milk","1 medium potato, cut into 1/2-inch cubes","1 1/2 cups frozen corn","1 1/2 cups cooked diced chicken","1/2 teaspoon garlic powder","1/4 teaspoon black pepper"}
shopping_list: {"1 10.5-ounce can condensed cream of chicken soup","2 cups chicken broth","1/2 cup milk","1 medium potato, cut into 1/2-inch cubes","1 1/2 cups frozen corn","1 1/2 cups cooked diced chicken","1/2 teaspoon garlic powder","1/4 teaspoon black pepper"}
recipe_steps: {"Whisk condensed soup, broth and milk together in a saucepan. Add potato and bring to a gentle simmer.","Cover loosely and simmer 12–15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until potato is tender.","Add corn, chicken, garlic powder and pepper. Simmer 5–7 minutes more, stirring, until hot throughout and the chicken reaches 165°F."}

title: Creamy Chicken Gnocchi Soup
description: Store-bought gnocchi turn leftover chicken into a filling creamy soup. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"1 tablespoon butter","1/2 cup frozen diced onion","3 cups chicken broth","1 16-ounce package shelf-stable potato gnocchi","1 1/2 cups cooked shredded chicken","1/2 cup heavy cream","2 cups baby spinach","1/2 teaspoon Italian seasoning"}
shopping_list: {"1 tablespoon butter","1/2 cup frozen diced onion","3 cups chicken broth","1 16-ounce package shelf-stable potato gnocchi","1 1/2 cups cooked shredded chicken","1/2 cup heavy cream","2 cups baby spinach","1/2 teaspoon Italian seasoning"}
recipe_steps: {"Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook onion for 4 minutes, stirring.","Add broth and Italian seasoning. Bring to a simmer, then add gnocchi and cook for the package time, usually 2–4 minutes.","Stir in chicken and cream. Simmer gently for 5–7 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F.","Stir in spinach just until wilted and serve."}

title: Chicken and Noodles in Gravy
description: Egg noodles, chicken and carrots in a thick gravy-style sauce. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"5 ounces dry egg noodles","1 cup frozen peas and carrots","1 1/2 cups cooked diced chicken","1 10.5-ounce can condensed cream of chicken soup","3/4 cup chicken broth","1/4 teaspoon black pepper"}
shopping_list: {"5 ounces dry egg noodles","1 cup frozen peas and carrots","1 1/2 cups cooked diced chicken","1 10.5-ounce can condensed cream of chicken soup","3/4 cup chicken broth","1/4 teaspoon black pepper"}
recipe_steps: {"Boil egg noodles for the package time. Add peas and carrots during the final 4 minutes, then drain.","Meanwhile stir soup and broth together in a saucepan. Add chicken and pepper; simmer gently for 6–8 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F.","Stir in the noodles and vegetables and heat together for 1–2 minutes."}

title: Chicken and Broccoli Rice Bake
description: A small chicken-and-rice casserole using cooked rice and frozen broccoli. About 10 minutes of hands-on work; 45 minutes total. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"2 cups cooked rice","2 cups cooked diced chicken","2 cups frozen chopped broccoli","1 10.5-ounce can condensed cream of chicken soup","3/4 cup milk","1 cup shredded cheddar","1/2 teaspoon garlic powder"}
shopping_list: {"2 cups cooked rice","2 cups cooked diced chicken","2 cups frozen chopped broccoli","1 10.5-ounce can condensed cream of chicken soup","3/4 cup milk","1 cup shredded cheddar","1/2 teaspoon garlic powder"}
recipe_steps: {"Heat oven to 375°F. Microwave the broccoli according to the package and drain excess water.","Mix rice, chicken, broccoli, soup, milk, garlic powder and half the cheese in an 8-inch square baking dish.","Cover with foil and bake 20 minutes. Uncover, add the remaining cheese and bake another 5–10 minutes, until bubbling and 165°F in the center.","Let stand for 5 minutes before dividing into four portions."}

title: Creamy Chicken Mushroom Skillet
description: Chicken cutlets with mushrooms in a simple creamy skillet sauce. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast cutlets, 1/2-inch thick","1 tablespoon oil","8 ounces sliced mushrooms","1/2 cup chicken broth","1/3 cup heavy cream","1/2 teaspoon garlic powder","1/4 teaspoon salt","1/4 teaspoon black pepper"}
shopping_list: {"12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast cutlets, 1/2-inch thick","1 tablespoon oil","8 ounces sliced mushrooms","1/2 cup chicken broth","1/3 cup heavy cream","1/2 teaspoon garlic powder","1/4 teaspoon salt","1/4 teaspoon black pepper"}
recipe_steps: {"Season chicken with salt and pepper. Heat oil over medium-high in a large skillet.","Cook cutlets 4–5 minutes per side until 165°F inside; place on a clean plate.","Cook mushrooms in the same pan for 6–8 minutes, stirring, until softened and browned. Add broth and scrape up browned bits.","Add cream and garlic powder; simmer gently 3 minutes. Return chicken and warm through in the sauce."}

title: Creamy Pesto Pasta
description: Penne with a creamy pesto sauce and cherry tomatoes. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library. The photo includes pine-nut garnish; extra nuts are optional and not needed for this recipe.
ingredients_list: {"6 ounces dry penne","3 tablespoons basil pesto","2 ounces cream cheese","1/3 cup milk","1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved","2 tablespoons grated Parmesan"}
shopping_list: {"6 ounces dry penne","3 tablespoons basil pesto","2 ounces cream cheese","1/3 cup milk","1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved","2 tablespoons grated Parmesan"}
recipe_steps: {"Boil penne according to its package. Save 1/4 cup of the cooking water before draining.","Put milk and cream cheese in the warm pot over low heat. Stir until smooth, then mix in pesto.","Add pasta and tomatoes. Warm for 2 minutes, adding a little reserved pasta water if needed. Sprinkle with Parmesan."}

title: Chicken Fajita Pasta
description: A mild fajita-style pasta with chicken, peppers and a creamy tomato sauce. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"6 ounces dry cavatappi pasta","10 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast, sliced thin","1 tablespoon oil","2 cups frozen pepper and onion strips","1 tablespoon mild fajita seasoning","1/2 cup tomato sauce","1/3 cup cream","1/4 cup shredded cheddar"}
shopping_list: {"6 ounces dry cavatappi pasta","10 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast, sliced thin","1 tablespoon oil","2 cups frozen pepper and onion strips","1 tablespoon mild fajita seasoning","1/2 cup tomato sauce","1/3 cup cream","1/4 cup shredded cheddar"}
recipe_steps: {"Cook pasta in boiling water according to its package, then drain.","Meanwhile heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Cook chicken strips 5–7 minutes, turning, until 165°F inside; transfer to a clean plate.","Cook frozen peppers and onions in the same pan for 6–8 minutes. Stir in seasoning and tomato sauce.","Return chicken and add cream, pasta and cheese. Stir over low heat for 2 minutes until the cheese melts."}

title: Easy Chicken Enchilada Soup
description: A pantry-friendly enchilada soup with chicken, beans and corn. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"2 cups chicken broth","1 10-ounce can mild red enchilada sauce","1 15-ounce can black beans, rinsed and drained","1 cup frozen corn","1 1/2 cups cooked shredded chicken","1/2 cup shredded cheddar","1 cup tortilla chips","1 avocado, diced"}
shopping_list: {"2 cups chicken broth","1 10-ounce can mild red enchilada sauce","1 15-ounce can black beans, rinsed and drained","1 cup frozen corn","1 1/2 cups cooked shredded chicken","1/2 cup shredded cheddar","1 cup tortilla chips","1 avocado, diced"}
recipe_steps: {"Combine broth, enchilada sauce, beans and corn in a saucepan. Bring to a gentle simmer for 8 minutes.","Add chicken and simmer 5–7 minutes until it reaches 165°F, stirring occasionally.","Ladle into bowls and top with cheese, broken tortilla chips and avocado."}

title: Easy White Chicken Chili
description: Mild white-bean chicken chili with a creamy salsa-verde broth. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library. Avocado and cilantro in the photo are optional serving garnishes.
ingredients_list: {"2 15-ounce cans great northern beans, rinsed and drained","1 1/2 cups cooked shredded chicken","2 cups chicken broth","1/2 cup mild salsa verde","1 teaspoon ground cumin","2 ounces cream cheese","1 lime, cut into wedges"}
shopping_list: {"2 15-ounce cans great northern beans, rinsed and drained","1 1/2 cups cooked shredded chicken","2 cups chicken broth","1/2 cup mild salsa verde","1 teaspoon ground cumin","2 ounces cream cheese","1 lime, cut into wedges"}
recipe_steps: {"Mash half a can of beans in a saucepan. Add the remaining beans, broth, salsa verde and cumin.","Simmer for 8 minutes. Stir in chicken and small pieces of cream cheese.","Simmer gently for 5–7 minutes, stirring until smooth and chicken reaches 165°F. Serve with lime wedges."}

title: Chicken Fried Rice with Frozen Vegetables
description: A practical fried-rice dinner with cooked chicken and frozen peas and carrots. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"2 cups cooked chilled rice","1 cup cooked diced chicken","1 cup frozen peas and carrots","2 eggs","1 tablespoon oil","2 tablespoons soy sauce","1 teaspoon sesame oil"}
shopping_list: {"2 cups cooked chilled rice","1 cup cooked diced chicken","1 cup frozen peas and carrots","2 eggs","1 tablespoon oil","2 tablespoons soy sauce","1 teaspoon sesame oil"}
recipe_steps: {"Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Cook frozen vegetables for 4–5 minutes, stirring.","Push vegetables aside. Crack eggs into the space and scramble until firm, then stir together.","Add rice, chicken and soy sauce. Stir-fry for 5–7 minutes, breaking up rice, until the chicken and rice reach 165°F.","Stir in sesame oil and serve. Use rice that was promptly chilled and refrigerated, not rice left on the counter."}

title: Crispy Frozen Fish Tacos
description: Crispy frozen fish fillets tucked into tortillas with a quick cabbage slaw. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"10 ounces frozen breaded fish fillets","4 6-inch flour tortillas","2 cups bagged shredded cabbage","2 tablespoons mayonnaise","1 lime","1/4 teaspoon salt"}
shopping_list: {"10 ounces frozen breaded fish fillets","4 6-inch flour tortillas","2 cups bagged shredded cabbage","2 tablespoons mayonnaise","1 lime","1/4 teaspoon salt"}
recipe_steps: {"Bake fish from frozen following its package temperature and full cooking time, until the center reaches 145°F. Allow about 20 minutes plus oven preheating; larger fillets may take longer.","Mix cabbage, mayonnaise, salt and juice from half the lime in a bowl.","Warm tortillas in a dry skillet, then fill with broken fish fillets and slaw. Cut the remaining lime into wedges for serving."}

title: Garlic Shrimp Tacos
description: Garlic shrimp tacos with cabbage and a simple lime sauce. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"12 ounces raw peeled deveined shrimp, thawed","1 tablespoon butter","2 garlic cloves, minced","4 6-inch tortillas","2 cups shredded cabbage","3 tablespoons plain Greek yogurt","1 lime","1/4 teaspoon salt"}
shopping_list: {"12 ounces raw peeled deveined shrimp, thawed","1 tablespoon butter","2 garlic cloves, minced","4 6-inch tortillas","2 cups shredded cabbage","3 tablespoons plain Greek yogurt","1 lime","1/4 teaspoon salt"}
recipe_steps: {"Mix yogurt, salt and juice from half the lime. Toss half this sauce with the cabbage.","Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in garlic for 30 seconds, then add shrimp in one layer.","Cook shrimp about 2–3 minutes per side until pearly, opaque and cooked through. Warm tortillas in another dry pan or the microwave.","Fill tortillas with slaw and shrimp. Add remaining sauce and serve with wedges from the other lime half."}

title: Black Bean Quesadillas
description: Black beans, corn and melted cheese in crisp folded tortillas. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library. Guacamole and pico de gallo pictured on the side are optional.
ingredients_list: {"1 15-ounce can black beans, rinsed and drained","1/2 cup frozen corn","3/4 cup shredded cheddar","4 8-inch flour tortillas","1/2 teaspoon ground cumin","2 tablespoons salsa","1 teaspoon oil"}
shopping_list: {"1 15-ounce can black beans, rinsed and drained","1/2 cup frozen corn","3/4 cup shredded cheddar","4 8-inch flour tortillas","1/2 teaspoon ground cumin","2 tablespoons salsa","1 teaspoon oil"}
recipe_steps: {"Microwave corn with a splash of water according to its package and drain. Mash half the beans, then mix with whole beans, corn, cumin and salsa.","Spread filling over half of each tortilla, add cheese and fold.","Heat oil in a skillet over medium-low. Cook folded tortillas in batches for 2–3 minutes per side until crisp and hot inside."}

title: Sheet Pan Beef Nachos
description: Sheet-pan nachos with taco beef, black beans and melted cheese. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library. Fresh chopped toppings in the photo can be replaced by the listed salsa.
ingredients_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","1 tablespoon taco seasoning","1/4 cup water","5 ounces tortilla chips","1 15-ounce can black beans, rinsed and drained","1 cup shredded cheddar","1/3 cup salsa","1/4 cup sour cream"}
shopping_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","1 tablespoon taco seasoning","5 ounces tortilla chips","1 15-ounce can black beans, rinsed and drained","1 cup shredded cheddar","1/3 cup salsa","1/4 cup sour cream"}
recipe_steps: {"Heat oven to 400°F. Brown beef in a skillet over medium-high for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up, until 160°F; drain excess fat.","Stir in taco seasoning, water and beans. Simmer 3 minutes.","Spread chips on a rimmed baking sheet. Spoon beef and beans over the chips and sprinkle with cheese. Bake 5–7 minutes until melted and hot.","Add salsa and sour cream just before serving."}

title: Loaded Taco Salad
description: A full taco dinner in a salad bowl with warm beef and crunchy tortilla chips. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library. The pictured avocado is optional; the listed meal uses tomato and corn.
ingredients_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","1 tablespoon taco seasoning","1/4 cup water","4 cups chopped romaine lettuce","1 cup canned black beans, rinsed and drained","1/2 cup thawed frozen corn","1 tomato, diced","1/2 cup shredded cheddar","1/3 cup salsa ranch dressing","1 cup tortilla chips"}
shopping_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","1 tablespoon taco seasoning","4 cups chopped romaine lettuce","1 cup canned black beans, rinsed and drained","1/2 cup thawed frozen corn","1 tomato, diced","1/2 cup shredded cheddar","1/3 cup salsa ranch dressing","1 cup tortilla chips"}
recipe_steps: {"Brown beef in a skillet over medium-high for 6–8 minutes, breaking it apart, until 160°F. Drain extra fat.","Add seasoning, water, beans and corn. Simmer for 3–4 minutes until hot.","Divide lettuce between bowls. Add tomato, warm beef mixture, cheese and broken chips. Drizzle with dressing just before eating."}

title: Cheesy Beef and Potato Skillet
description: A filling skillet of diced potatoes, ground beef and melted cheddar. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library. Green onion shown in the photo is an optional garnish.
ingredients_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","12 ounces potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch cubes","1/2 small onion, diced","1 tablespoon oil","1/2 teaspoon garlic powder","1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika","1/4 teaspoon salt","1/2 cup shredded cheddar","2 tablespoons water"}
shopping_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","12 ounces potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch cubes","1/2 small onion, diced","1 tablespoon oil","1/2 teaspoon garlic powder","1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika","1/4 teaspoon salt","1/2 cup shredded cheddar"}
recipe_steps: {"Put potatoes and water in a covered microwave-safe bowl with a vent. Microwave 5–7 minutes until nearly tender; drain carefully.","Meanwhile heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Add onion and beef; cook 6–8 minutes, breaking beef apart, until 160°F.","Add potatoes, garlic powder, paprika and salt. Cook 7–10 minutes, turning occasionally, until potatoes are tender and browned.","Sprinkle with cheddar. Cover over low heat for a minute until melted."}

title: American Goulash
description: Tomato-rich beef and macaroni with kidney beans for a filling pantry dinner. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","6 ounces dry elbow macaroni","1/2 small onion, diced","2 cups jarred marinara sauce","1 cup canned kidney beans, rinsed and drained","1/2 teaspoon garlic powder","1/2 cup shredded cheddar"}
shopping_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","6 ounces dry elbow macaroni","1/2 small onion, diced","2 cups jarred marinara sauce","1 cup canned kidney beans, rinsed and drained","1/2 teaspoon garlic powder","1/2 cup shredded cheddar"}
recipe_steps: {"Boil macaroni for the package time and drain, saving 1/2 cup cooking water.","Meanwhile cook beef and onion in a large skillet over medium-high for 7–9 minutes, breaking beef apart, until 160°F. Drain extra fat.","Add marinara, beans and garlic powder. Simmer gently for 5 minutes.","Stir in macaroni and enough reserved cooking water to loosen the sauce. Warm for 2 minutes and sprinkle with cheddar."}

title: Beef and Bean Burrito Bowls
description: Taco beef, rice and beans in bowls with corn, cheese and avocado. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library. Lime and cilantro pictured are optional garnishes.
ingredients_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","1 tablespoon taco seasoning","1/4 cup water","1 8.8-ounce pouch microwave rice","1 cup canned black beans, rinsed and drained","1/2 cup frozen corn","1/3 cup shredded cheddar","1 avocado, diced","1/4 cup salsa"}
shopping_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","1 tablespoon taco seasoning","1 8.8-ounce pouch microwave rice","1 cup canned black beans, rinsed and drained","1/2 cup frozen corn","1/3 cup shredded cheddar","1 avocado, diced","1/4 cup salsa"}
recipe_steps: {"Brown beef over medium-high for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up, until 160°F. Drain excess fat.","Stir in seasoning, water, beans and corn. Simmer 4–5 minutes until hot throughout.","Microwave rice following its package and divide into two bowls. Add beef mixture, cheese, avocado and salsa."}

title: French Onion Beef Sliders
description: Mini beef burgers with softened onions and Swiss cheese. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library. The photo includes a dipping jus; this short recipe does not require one.
ingredients_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","1 small onion, thinly sliced","1 tablespoon butter","1 teaspoon dry onion soup mix","2 tablespoons water","2 slices Swiss cheese, halved","4 slider buns"}
shopping_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","1 small onion, thinly sliced","1 tablespoon butter","1 teaspoon dry onion soup mix","2 slices Swiss cheese, halved","4 slider buns"}
recipe_steps: {"Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add onion and water; cover for 5 minutes, then uncover and cook 7–8 minutes, stirring, until soft and golden. Transfer to a bowl.","Mix beef with onion soup mix and shape into four thin patties.","Cook patties in the same skillet over medium-high for about 3–4 minutes per side, until 160°F. Add Swiss and cover briefly to melt.","Place patties and onions in the split slider buns and serve."}

title: Mushroom Swiss Burgers
description: Beef burgers topped with browned mushrooms and Swiss cheese. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library. Fries shown alongside are an optional extra.
ingredients_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","6 ounces sliced mushrooms","1 tablespoon butter","2 slices Swiss cheese","2 burger buns","1/4 teaspoon salt","1/4 teaspoon black pepper"}
shopping_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","6 ounces sliced mushrooms","1 tablespoon butter","2 slices Swiss cheese","2 burger buns","1/4 teaspoon salt","1/4 teaspoon black pepper"}
recipe_steps: {"Melt butter in a skillet over medium-high. Cook mushrooms for 7–9 minutes, stirring, until browned. Transfer to a bowl.","Shape beef into two patties about 1/2-inch thick and season with salt and pepper.","Cook in the hot skillet 4–5 minutes per side until the centers reach 160°F. Add Swiss and cover for a minute to melt.","Put burgers in the buns and spoon mushrooms over the cheese."}

title: Bacon BBQ Burgers
description: Classic burgers with cheddar, barbecue sauce and crisp bacon. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library. The onion ring in the serving illustration is optional and not included in the short ingredient list.
ingredients_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","2 burger buns","2 slices cheddar","4 slices fully cooked bacon","2 tablespoons barbecue sauce","1/4 teaspoon salt","1/4 teaspoon black pepper"}
shopping_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","2 burger buns","2 slices cheddar","4 slices fully cooked bacon","2 tablespoons barbecue sauce","1/4 teaspoon salt","1/4 teaspoon black pepper"}
recipe_steps: {"Shape beef into two 1/2-inch-thick patties. Sprinkle both sides with salt and pepper.","Heat a skillet over medium-high. Cook patties about 4–5 minutes per side until the center reaches 160°F.","Add cheddar and cover for a minute. Heat the fully cooked bacon following its package.","Fill buns with burgers, bacon and barbecue sauce."}

title: Philly Sloppy Joes
description: Sloppy joes with peppers, onions and melted provolone. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"3/4 pound lean ground beef","1 bell pepper, diced","1/2 onion, diced","1/2 cup beef broth","1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce","1 tablespoon ketchup","1 teaspoon cornstarch","3 slices provolone","3 hamburger buns"}
shopping_list: {"3/4 pound lean ground beef","1 bell pepper, diced","1/2 onion, diced","1/2 cup beef broth","1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce","1 tablespoon ketchup","1 teaspoon cornstarch","3 slices provolone","3 hamburger buns"}
recipe_steps: {"Cook beef, pepper and onion in a large skillet over medium-high for 9–11 minutes, breaking beef apart, until beef reaches 160°F and vegetables soften. Drain excess fat.","Whisk broth with cornstarch, Worcestershire sauce and ketchup. Add to the skillet and simmer 3–5 minutes, stirring until thick enough to stay on a bun.","Lay provolone over the filling and cover over low heat until melted. Divide the filling between split buns."}

title: Easy Beef and Bean Enchiladas
description: Rolled beef-and-bean enchiladas with canned sauce and melted cheese. About 15 minutes of hands-on work; 45 minutes total. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","1 cup canned black beans, rinsed and drained","1 tablespoon taco seasoning","1/4 cup water","6 8-inch flour tortillas","1 15-ounce can mild red enchilada sauce","1 cup shredded cheddar","1/4 cup sour cream"}
shopping_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","1 cup canned black beans, rinsed and drained","1 tablespoon taco seasoning","6 8-inch flour tortillas","1 15-ounce can mild red enchilada sauce","1 cup shredded cheddar","1/4 cup sour cream"}
recipe_steps: {"Heat oven to 375°F. Brown beef in a skillet for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up, until 160°F. Drain excess fat.","Add beans, seasoning and water. Simmer 3 minutes. Spread 1/4 cup enchilada sauce in an 8-by-11-inch baking dish.","Divide filling and half the cheese among tortillas. Roll and arrange seam-side down in the dish.","Pour over remaining sauce and cheese. Cover with foil and bake 20 minutes, then uncover for 5 minutes, until 165°F in the center.","Let stand 5 minutes and serve with sour cream."}

title: Ham and Swiss Sub Sandwiches
description: Cold ham-and-Swiss subs with crunchy lettuce and tomato. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"2 6-inch sub rolls","6 ounces ready-to-eat deli ham","2 slices Swiss cheese","2 lettuce leaves","1 tomato, sliced","2 tablespoons mayonnaise","1 teaspoon mustard","2 thin slices red onion"}
shopping_list: {"2 6-inch sub rolls","6 ounces ready-to-eat deli ham","2 slices Swiss cheese","2 lettuce leaves","1 tomato, sliced","2 tablespoons mayonnaise","1 teaspoon mustard","2 thin slices red onion"}
recipe_steps: {"Split the rolls lengthwise. Stir mayonnaise and mustard together and spread inside.","Layer ham, Swiss, washed lettuce, tomato and onion in each roll.","Close the sandwiches and cut in half. Eat immediately or refrigerate promptly in a covered container."}

title: Pizza Bagels
description: Toasted bagels with pizza sauce, cheese and pepperoni. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library. Basil garnish and extra bread in the illustration are optional.
ingredients_list: {"2 plain bagels","1/3 cup pizza sauce","3/4 cup shredded mozzarella","16 pepperoni slices"}
shopping_list: {"2 plain bagels","1/3 cup pizza sauce","3/4 cup shredded mozzarella","16 pepperoni slices"}
recipe_steps: {"Heat oven to 425°F. Split bagels and place cut-side up on a baking sheet; toast for 3 minutes.","Spread with pizza sauce and add mozzarella and pepperoni.","Bake another 6–8 minutes until cheese is bubbling and edges are crisp. Cool for 2 minutes before eating."}

title: Chorizo, Egg and Potato Breakfast Skillet
description: A hearty breakfast-for-dinner skillet of chorizo, potatoes, peppers and eggs. Photo: Mmm... I love my skillet by jeffreyw. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/7927684@N03/6058830869 License: CC BY 2.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/). Resized and recompressed. The source photo has softer eggs; cook the eggs until whites and yolks are firm.
ingredients_list: {"6 ounces raw Mexican pork chorizo","12 ounces potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch cubes","1/2 bell pepper, diced","1/2 onion, diced","2 eggs","1 teaspoon oil","2 tablespoons water"}
shopping_list: {"6 ounces raw Mexican pork chorizo","12 ounces potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch cubes","1/2 bell pepper, diced","1/2 onion, diced","2 eggs","1 teaspoon oil"}
recipe_steps: {"Microwave potatoes and water in a covered, vented microwave-safe bowl for 5–7 minutes until nearly tender. Drain carefully.","Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium. Cook chorizo, onion and pepper for 7–9 minutes, crumbling the sausage, until the pork reaches 160°F.","Add potatoes and cook 5–7 minutes, turning, until tender and browned.","Make two spaces and crack in eggs. Cover over low heat for 4–6 minutes, until both whites and yolks are firm."}

title: Breakfast Tacos with Eggs and Sausage
description: Sausage, potato and scrambled-egg tacos that work for breakfast or dinner. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"4 ounces raw breakfast pork sausage","1 cup frozen diced hash-brown potatoes","3 eggs","4 6-inch tortillas","1/4 cup shredded cheddar","1/4 cup pico de gallo","1 teaspoon oil"}
shopping_list: {"4 ounces raw breakfast pork sausage","1 cup frozen diced hash-brown potatoes","3 eggs","4 6-inch tortillas","1/4 cup shredded cheddar","1/4 cup pico de gallo","1 teaspoon oil"}
recipe_steps: {"Heat oil in a skillet over medium. Cook sausage and frozen potatoes for 10–12 minutes, crumbling sausage and turning potatoes, until sausage reaches 160°F and potatoes are tender.","Beat eggs in a bowl. Pour into the skillet and stir gently for 2–3 minutes until fully set.","Warm tortillas in a dry pan or microwave. Fill with the egg mixture, cheddar and pico de gallo."}

title: Chicken and Waffles Shortcut Dinner
description: Chicken and waffles using freezer staples for breakfast-for-dinner. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library. Berries in the photo are an optional side.
ingredients_list: {"10 ounces frozen fully cooked breaded chicken tenders","4 frozen toaster waffles","2 tablespoons maple syrup","1 tablespoon butter"}
shopping_list: {"10 ounces frozen fully cooked breaded chicken tenders","4 frozen toaster waffles","2 tablespoons maple syrup","1 tablespoon butter"}
recipe_steps: {"Preheat the oven and bake fully cooked chicken tenders following their package, until crisp and 165°F inside; allow about 20 minutes plus preheating.","Near the end of baking, toast waffles according to their package.","Divide waffles and chicken between plates. Add butter to the hot waffles and drizzle with maple syrup."}

title: Peanut Sesame Noodles
description: Spaghetti in a peanut-sesame sauce with crisp cucumber. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"6 ounces dry spaghetti","3 tablespoons peanut butter","1 tablespoon soy sauce","1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil","1 tablespoon lime juice","3 tablespoons warm water","1/2 cucumber, cut into thin strips","1 tablespoon chopped peanuts","1 teaspoon sesame seeds"}
shopping_list: {"6 ounces dry spaghetti","3 tablespoons peanut butter","1 tablespoon soy sauce","1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil","1 tablespoon lime juice","1/2 cucumber, cut into thin strips","1 tablespoon chopped peanuts","1 teaspoon sesame seeds"}
recipe_steps: {"Boil spaghetti according to its package. Drain and rinse briefly under cool water.","Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil, lime juice and warm water until smooth.","Toss noodles and cucumber with the sauce. Divide into bowls and sprinkle with peanuts and sesame seeds."}

title: Quick Chicken Shawarma Wraps
description: A quick shawarma-style pita dinner using a ready-mixed seasoning. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library. The pictured fries are optional.
ingredients_list: {"12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into thin strips","1 tablespoon oil","2 teaspoons shawarma seasoning","2 pita breads","1/3 cup plain Greek yogurt","1 tablespoon lemon juice","1/2 cucumber, diced","1 tomato, diced","1 cup shredded lettuce"}
shopping_list: {"12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into thin strips","1 tablespoon oil","2 teaspoons shawarma seasoning","2 pita breads","1/3 cup plain Greek yogurt","1 tablespoon lemon juice","1/2 cucumber, diced","1 tomato, diced","1 cup shredded lettuce"}
recipe_steps: {"Toss chicken with oil and shawarma seasoning. Heat a skillet over medium-high.","Cook chicken 7–9 minutes, turning often, until it reaches 165°F. This shortcut skips the long marinade.","Mix yogurt and lemon juice. Warm pitas according to their package and open into pockets.","Fill with chicken, cucumber, tomato and lettuce. Spoon yogurt sauce inside."}

title: Greek Chicken Rice Bowls
description: Greek-style chicken bowls with rice, fresh vegetables and hummus. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library. The illustration serves chicken on skewers; the recipe cooks loose pieces in a skillet.
ingredients_list: {"12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces","1 tablespoon oil","1 teaspoon Greek seasoning","1 8.8-ounce pouch microwave rice","1/2 cucumber, diced","1 tomato, diced","1/4 cup crumbled feta","1/4 cup hummus","1/4 cup tzatziki","1 tablespoon lemon juice"}
shopping_list: {"12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces","1 tablespoon oil","1 teaspoon Greek seasoning","1 8.8-ounce pouch microwave rice","1/2 cucumber, diced","1 tomato, diced","1/4 cup crumbled feta","1/4 cup hummus","1/4 cup tzatziki","1 tablespoon lemon juice"}
recipe_steps: {"Toss chicken with oil and Greek seasoning. Cook in a skillet over medium-high for 7–9 minutes, stirring, until 165°F inside.","Heat rice following the pouch instructions. Divide into two bowls.","Top with chicken, cucumber, tomato and feta. Add hummus and tzatziki, then drizzle chicken with lemon juice."}

title: Ranch Chicken Tray Bake
description: Ranch-crusted chicken with broccoli and instant mashed potatoes. About 10 minutes of hands-on work; 40 minutes total. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast cutlets, 1/2-inch thick","1 tablespoon mayonnaise","1 tablespoon dry ranch seasoning","1/3 cup plain breadcrumbs","3 cups broccoli florets","1 tablespoon oil","1 4-ounce pouch complete instant mashed potatoes, water-only preparation","2 cups water"}
shopping_list: {"12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast cutlets, 1/2-inch thick","1 tablespoon mayonnaise","1 tablespoon dry ranch seasoning","1/3 cup plain breadcrumbs","3 cups broccoli florets","1 tablespoon oil","1 4-ounce pouch complete instant mashed potatoes, water-only preparation"}
recipe_steps: {"Heat oven to 400°F. Stir ranch seasoning into breadcrumbs. Spread mayonnaise thinly on chicken and press into the crumbs.","Place chicken on one side of a large lined baking sheet. Toss broccoli with oil and put on the other side.","Bake 20–25 minutes, turning broccoli halfway, until chicken reaches 165°F and broccoli is tender.","Prepare the mashed potatoes with the 2 cups water, or the water amount printed on the pouch. Serve alongside chicken and broccoli."}

title: Salisbury Steak with Gravy
description: Simple beef patties with mushroom gravy and mashed potatoes. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library. Carrots and green beans pictured are optional sides.
ingredients_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","2 tablespoons plain breadcrumbs","2 tablespoons milk","1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce","1 tablespoon oil","6 ounces sliced mushrooms","1 12-ounce jar beef gravy","1 4-ounce pouch complete instant mashed potatoes, water-only preparation","2 cups water"}
shopping_list: {"1/2 pound lean ground beef","2 tablespoons plain breadcrumbs","2 tablespoons milk","1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce","1 tablespoon oil","6 ounces sliced mushrooms","1 12-ounce jar beef gravy","1 4-ounce pouch complete instant mashed potatoes, water-only preparation"}
recipe_steps: {"Mix beef, breadcrumbs, milk and Worcestershire sauce. Shape into two oval patties about 1/2-inch thick.","Heat oil in a skillet over medium. Brown patties 4–5 minutes per side until 160°F inside; transfer to a clean plate.","Cook mushrooms in the skillet for 5–6 minutes. Stir in gravy, return patties and simmer gently for 3 minutes.","Prepare instant mash with 2 cups water, or the pouch’s stated water amount. Serve patties and gravy over the mash."}

title: Shortcut Chicken Tetrazzini
description: A small creamy chicken-spaghetti bake with mushrooms and a crisp cheese topping. About 15 minutes of hands-on work; 50 minutes total. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"6 ounces dry spaghetti","1 1/2 cups cooked diced chicken","1 10.5-ounce can condensed cream of mushroom soup","1/2 cup milk","1 4-ounce can sliced mushrooms, drained","1/2 cup shredded mozzarella","1/4 cup grated Parmesan","2 tablespoons breadcrumbs"}
shopping_list: {"6 ounces dry spaghetti","1 1/2 cups cooked diced chicken","1 10.5-ounce can condensed cream of mushroom soup","1/2 cup milk","1 4-ounce can sliced mushrooms, drained","1/2 cup shredded mozzarella","1/4 cup grated Parmesan","2 tablespoons breadcrumbs"}
recipe_steps: {"Heat oven to 375°F. Boil spaghetti for 1 minute less than its package time and drain.","Mix soup and milk in an 8-inch square baking dish. Stir in chicken, drained mushrooms and spaghetti.","Sprinkle mozzarella, Parmesan and breadcrumbs over the top. Bake uncovered for 20–25 minutes until browned, bubbling and 165°F in the center.","Let stand 3 minutes before serving."}

title: Cheesy Salsa Chicken
description: Chicken breasts baked under mild salsa and melted cheddar. About 5 minutes of hands-on work; 40 minutes total. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"2 6-ounce boneless skinless chicken breasts, pounded to 3/4-inch thickness","3/4 cup mild chunky salsa","1/2 cup shredded cheddar","1 teaspoon taco seasoning","1 teaspoon oil"}
shopping_list: {"2 6-ounce boneless skinless chicken breasts, pounded to 3/4-inch thickness","3/4 cup mild chunky salsa","1/2 cup shredded cheddar","1 teaspoon taco seasoning","1 teaspoon oil"}
recipe_steps: {"Heat oven to 400°F. Oil a small baking dish and place chicken in one layer.","Sprinkle with taco seasoning and spoon salsa over the top. Bake for 20–25 minutes.","Add cheddar and bake another 5 minutes, until cheese melts and the thickest chicken reaches 165°F. Let stand 5 minutes."}

title: Chicken, Ham and Swiss Bake
description: Chicken cutlets baked with ham, Swiss and a creamy mustard sauce. About 10 minutes of hands-on work; 45 minutes total. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.

shopping_list: {"12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast cutlets, 1/2-inch thick","2 ounces ready-to-eat deli ham","2 slices Swiss cheese","1/2 10.5-ounce can condensed cream of chicken soup","1/4 cup milk","1 teaspoon Dijon mustard","2 tablespoons breadcrumbs","1 teaspoon oil"}
recipe_steps: {"Heat oven to 400°F. Lightly oil a small baking dish. Whisk soup, milk and mustard in the dish.","Lay cutlets in the sauce in one layer. Top each with ham, Swiss and breadcrumbs.","Bake 25–30 minutes until the thickest chicken reaches 165°F and the sauce bubbles. Rest 5 minutes before serving."}

title: Crispy Chicken Mashed Potato Bowls
description: Crispy chicken, corn and gravy piled onto instant mashed potatoes. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.

shopping_list: {"8 ounces frozen fully cooked breaded chicken nuggets","1 4-ounce pouch complete instant mashed potatoes, water-only preparation","1 cup frozen corn","1 cup prepared chicken gravy","1/3 cup shredded cheddar"}
recipe_steps: {"Heat oven and bake fully cooked nuggets according to the package, until crisp and 165°F inside. Heat gravy in a small saucepan until bubbling, stirring.","Prepare mashed potatoes using 2 cups water, or the water amount stated on the pouch.","Divide mash into bowls and top with corn, chicken, gravy and cheddar."}

title: Chicken Marinara Spaghetti
description: A fast red-sauce spaghetti dinner using leftover cooked chicken. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"6 ounces dry spaghetti","1 1/2 cups jarred marinara sauce","1 1/2 cups cooked shredded chicken","1 teaspoon Italian seasoning","2 tablespoons grated Parmesan"}
shopping_list: {"6 ounces dry spaghetti","1 1/2 cups jarred marinara sauce","1 1/2 cups cooked shredded chicken","1 teaspoon Italian seasoning","2 tablespoons grated Parmesan"}
recipe_steps: {"Boil spaghetti for the time on its package and drain.","Meanwhile combine marinara, chicken and Italian seasoning in a saucepan. Simmer gently for 6–8 minutes, stirring, until chicken reaches 165°F.","Toss spaghetti with the hot sauce and serve with Parmesan."}

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken and Potatoes
description: Lemon-garlic chicken with roasted potatoes and asparagus. About 15 minutes of hands-on work; 60 minutes total. Serving illustration from the Mealsolved image library.
ingredients_list: {"12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast cutlets, 3/4-inch thick","1 pound baby potatoes, quartered","1/2 pound asparagus, tough ends removed","2 tablespoons oil","1 lemon","3 garlic cloves, minced","1 teaspoon Italian seasoning","1/2 teaspoon salt"}
shopping_list: {"12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast cutlets, 3/4-inch thick","1 pound baby potatoes, quartered","1/2 pound asparagus, tough ends removed","2 tablespoons oil","1 lemon","3 garlic cloves, minced","1 teaspoon Italian seasoning","1/2 teaspoon salt"}
recipe_steps: {"Heat oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes with half the oil and half the salt on a large rimmed baking sheet. Roast 20 minutes.","Mix remaining oil and salt with garlic, Italian seasoning and juice from half the lemon. Coat chicken with half this mixture and add to the tray. Roast 15 minutes.","Toss asparagus with the remaining mixture and add to the tray. Roast another 10 minutes, until chicken reaches 165°F and potatoes are fork-tender.","Rest chicken 5 minutes. Slice the remaining lemon half and serve alongside."}
